seoTitle: Maryland School Calendar 2026-2027: Start Dates, Holidays, Breaks & District Calendars
seoDescription: Find Maryland school calendars for 2026-2027, including Baltimore City, Baltimore County, Howard County, Montgomery County and Prince George's County start dates, holidays, breaks, PDFs and downloads.
about:
Maryland public school calendars are approved locally by each school system, so first day of school, last day, winter break, spring break, professional days, parent conference days, religious observance notes, and make-up day plans can vary by county. The Washington, D.C. suburbs are especially important for calendar planning because many families compare Montgomery County Public Schools, Prince George's County Public Schools, District of Columbia schools, and Northern Virginia school divisions.

Families should use each district calendar as the source of record for attendance planning, then verify school-specific details for testing, graduation, athletics, performances, magnet programs, transportation notices, and weather closures. MySchoolDates organizes available Maryland district calendar pages and links back to official district sources for final verification.

planningTips: Compare Montgomery County and Prince George's County dates separately because nearby Maryland systems may not share the same professional days or break timing.
Check teacher workdays, professional days, grading days, and conference days before arranging childcare.
Review weather make-up language before booking June travel because closures can affect the final student day.
Use official district announcements for emergency closures, delayed openings, early dismissals, and school-specific updates.

faqs.a: Maryland school start dates vary by district. Many systems begin in late August or early September, but families should select a district calendar below to confirm the official first day.

faqs.q: Are Maryland school calendars the same statewide?
faqs.a: No. Maryland public school calendars are approved locally, so first day, last day, holidays, breaks, professional days, and make-up day plans can differ by county school system.

faqs.a: Many Maryland districts include make-up day language or revise calendars after weather and emergency closures. Families should verify the official district calendar before making June travel plans.
